description: This file defines the 'Account' entity class for a banking application. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping, and Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction. The class models a bank account with fields such as id, accountNumber, associated bank information, status, type, balance, and timestamps.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Entity class representing a bank account, with fields for account identification, status, type, balance, creation and update timestamps, and related bank info.
